annotations.exact_quote: Co-saliency detection aims at extracting the common salient regions from an image group containing two or more relevant images.
annotations.reason_zh: 该任务从图像组中提取共同显著区域，属于像素级区域/前景区域划分。

annotations.exact_quote: Different from the most existing co-saliency methods focusing on RGB images, this paper proposes a novel co-saliency detection model for RGBD images, which utilizes the depth information to enhance identification of co-saliency.
annotations.reason_zh: RGBD 图像提供 RGB 与深度两个互补观测，论文显式引入并利用深度信息增强共同显著性识别。

多约束特征匹配表示图像间约束关系，但未说明学习或修正样本间边、邻接或亲和矩阵，缺定义所需证据。
cross label propagation 可能涉及图上一致性，但摘要未提邻域、图拉普拉斯或流形约束，难判是否满足定义。
